description: Manage and view i18n files of any project, for humans and agents
command.extractFile: Extract All Hard Strings in File
config.enabled: Run the x18n language server in this workspace.
config.useLocalServer: Run the `@x18n/lsp` installed in the workspace's `node_modules` instead of the bundled server, when there is one. Restart the server after changing this.
config.annotations: Show translated values next to or in place of keys in code.
config.annotationInPlace: Replace keys in code with their display-locale value. The raw key shows on the cursor line and inside selections.
config.annotationInPlaceFullMatch: In in-place mode, replace the whole translate call, such as `t('key', { n })`, instead of only the key. Keys whose call is not known keep the key-only replacement.
config.annotationMaxLength: Longest value shown in an annotation. Longer values are truncated, and in-place mode falls back to an after-key hint.
config.language: Language of x18n's messages, prompts and views. Empty follows VS Code's display language. Command titles and setting descriptions always follow VS Code's display language.
config.displayLocale: Locale shown in annotations. Empty means the source locale. "x18n: Set Display Locale" overrides it per workspace without writing settings, until this setting changes or you pick "Default".
config.showFlags: Show the flag of each locale in views, pickers, hovers and the status bar.
config.theme.annotation: CSS color of in-place values. Empty uses the inlay hint color of the theme.
config.theme.annotationMissing: CSS color of keys without a value. Empty uses the warning color of the theme.
config.theme.annotationBorder: CSS border color of in-place values. Empty draws no border.
config.theme.annotationMissingBorder: CSS border color of keys without a value. Empty draws no border.
config.theme.annotationInPlaceFullMatch: CSS color of values that replace a whole call (`x18n.annotationInPlaceFullMatch`). Empty uses `x18n.theme.annotation`.
config.codeLens: Show usage counts and missing locales above keys in resource files.
config.trace.server: Trace the communication between VS Code and the x18n language server.
